items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: And they would take these bebop tunes and make them sound like King Oliver or Thelonious Monk or Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: Is it a hurdle for trad jazz to be heard and sort of accepted because it’s not really an opportunity for new compositions?

Well no. There’s been some people who have taken a trad jazz approach to like bebop. There is a wonderful band that used to be in Paris. The musicians are all alive, but they’re not playing anymore, called the Anachronic Jazz Band. And they would take these bebop tunes and make them sound like King Oliver or Thelonious Monk or Charlie Parker. It was amazing. I was totally knocked out on their imagination and how to do this. I think there can be musicians today who can still write in a style of Jelly Roll Morton…
